paite: Judah Kumpipa Ahaz akum sawm-le-nihna alal kum in Elah tapa Hoshea Israelte tung ah Samaria ah alal pan a, kum kua alal hi.
heading: Israel Kumpipa Hoshea

paite: TOUPA mitmuh in thil hoih loutak ahih a, himahleh ama a Israel kumpipate bang zen in zaw ahih kei.
Assuria kumpipa Salmaneser in ava dou a, huchi in Hoshea asikha ahong hi a, siah apia hi.

Assuria kumpipa'n, Aigupta kumpipa So kiang a mi sawl in Hoshea thuguk sawm ana theikhia a; a kumchin a, apiak zel bang in leng Assuria kumpipa kiang ah siah ape kei behlap lai a; huaiziak in Assuria kumpipa'n suangkul ah hensa in akhumta hi.
Huchi in Assuria kumpipa'n gam tengteng atuansuak vek a, Samaria ah ahohtou a, kum thum a-umkhum hi.
heading: Samaria Pukna

paite: Hoshea kum kua alal kum in Assuria kumpipa'n Samaria ala a, Assuria gam ah Israelte api a, Halah, Habor a Gozan lui leh Mediate khuate ah akoih hi.
Huchibang a, ana omna uh bel Israel suante'n Aigupta kumpipa Pharaoh khut nuai a pan, Aigupta gam a pan a pikhepa TOUPA a Pathian uh tung a thil ahihkhelh ua, pathian dangte alau ziak uh ahi.
TOUPA'N Israel suante ma a, ana delhkhiaksa namte thuzoh leh Israel kumpipate dan thusehte azuih zawk ziak uh leng ahi.
Israel suante'n TOUPA a Pathian uh tung ah thil hoih loutak aguk in ahih uhi. Akho teng uah galvil mite insang a pan kulh nei khopite pha in mun sangte abawl uhi.
Mual sang teng ah pathian limte leh sing hing teng nuai ah suangphuhte phut in Asherah songte abawl uhi.
Huai mun sang tengteng ah TOUPA'N ama ua adelhmangsa namte hih bang in gimlim ahal ua; TOUPA hehsak ding in thil gilou ahih lai uhi.
TOUPA'N akiang uah, "Hichibang hih kei un," achih milimte nna leng asem uhi.

TOUPA'N, dan zuih ding na pi-le-pute uh ka piakleh ka sikha zawlneite zang a ka hon theihsak bang zel in, "Na omdan gilou uh lehngatsan unla, ka thupiakte leh ka dan thusehte zui un," chi in Israelte leh Judah zawlnei chih leh mu thei michih zang in atheisak hi.
Huchi pipi in leng azui nuam kei ua, api-le-pute un TOUPA a Pathian uh gingta nuam lou a, angawng uh akhauhsak mah bang un, angawng uh akhauhsak uhi.

Adan thusehte, api-le-pute uh toh athukhun, akiang ua athu theihsakte anial ua; thil gina lou azui ua, bangmah lou phet ahong hita uh. Atungthu ua TOUPA'N, amau bang in zaw hih kei un, ana chihsa, akiang ua namte azui uhi.
TOUPA a Pathian uh thupiak tengteng alehngatsan ua, bawngnou lim sun nih abawl ua, Asherah song abawl ua, van a om tengteng abia ua, Baal nna asem uhi.
Atapate uh leh atanute uh mei tawn in alutsak ua, aisan leh bum aching ua, TOUPA hehna tokthou ding in amitmuh in thil hoih lou hih ding in akizuak uhi.
Huaiziak in TOUPA Israelte tung ah heh petmah in aheh a, amuh phaklouhna ding ah asuanmang a; Judah nam kia lou ngal a-omta kei uhi.
Judahte'n leng TOUPA a Pathian uh thupiakte azui kei ua, Israelte bawltawm dan thusehte azui zawta uhi.
Israel suante himhim adeihta kei a, amau ahihgim a, amuh phak louh ua asuanmang masiah lok mite khut ah apia hi.

Israelte lah David inkote ahihna uh apaihsakta ngal a; huchi in Nebat tapa Jeroboam pen kumpipa ding in abawl ua; Jeroboam in Israelte'n TOUPA azuih uh ahawlkawi a, thil gilou thupi mahmah ahihsak hi.
Israel suante'n Jeroboam thilhihkhelh bangbang ahih sam ua;

TOUPA'N azawlnei tengteng zang a ana gensa bang a amuh phaklouhna a, asuanmang masiah huaite apaisan ngal kei ua. Huchi in Israelte amau gam a pan Assuria gam ah api ua, tuni tan in huai gam ah a-om lai uhi.

Assuria kumpipa'n Babulon khomite, Kuth khomite, Ava khomite, Hamath khomite leh Sepharvaim khomite athukhak a, Samaria khote ah Israel suante mun aluahsak a; huchi in Samaria gam aluah ua, akhuate ah ateng uhi.
heading: Israel Ah Assuriate Ateng Uh

paite: Huai lai a a-om tung un hichi ahong hi a, TOUPA laudan asiam kei ua, huchi in TOUPA'N alak uah humpinelkaite asawl a, khenkhatte akeilum uhi.

Huchi in Assuria kumpipa kiang ah, “Na lakkhiak a, Samaria gam khuate a na koih namte'n hiai gam Pathian omdan athei kei ua, huaiziak in, alak uah humpinelkaite asawl a; ngai dih, hiai gam Pathian omdan atheih louh ziak un athat uh," achi uhi.
Huchi in Assuria kumpipa'n, "Huai a sal a na pite uh lak a siampu khat pi unla, hong om sam henla, ama'n huai gam Pathian biakdan sinsak hen," chi in thu apia hi.
Huchi in Samaria gam a pan apite uh lak a siampu khat Bethel ah ava teng a, TOUPA laudan ding asinsak hi.
Himahleh nam chih in amau pathian chiat akibawl ua, Samari mite'n mun sang ana bawl innte ah nam chih in amau omna khua chiat ah huai apathiante chiat uh akoih uhi.
Babulon mite'n Sukkoth-benoth abawl ua, Kuthte'n Nergal abawl ua, Hamathte'n Ashima abawl ua;
Ava mite'n Nibhaz leh Tartak abawl uhi. Sepharvaim mite'n pathiante Adrammelek leh Anammelek kiang ah atate ahal uhi.
Huchi in TOUPA laudan asiam ua, alak ua mineupente mun sang siampute in abawl ua, mun sang innte ah amau a ding in thil alan uhi.
TOUPA alau ua, apikhiakna gam ua namte hihdan bang in amau pathiante nna asem uh.
Tuma lam a, ahihdan bang un tuni tan in ahih lailai uhi. TOUPA laudan asiam kei ua, TOUPA'N Jakob suan Israel achihte kiang ah,
"pathian dangte zaw lau kei unla, amau be kei unla, akiang ah kithoih sam kei un.
TOUPA, thilhihtheihna thupitak leh ban zak hial a Aigupta gam a pan nou hon pikhepa amah laudan na siam zawk ding uh ahi, amah na biak ding uh ahi a, ama kiang a na kithoih ding uh ahi.
Huchi in dan thusehte, vaihawmte, dante, thupiakte ahon na gelhsaksate tangtawn in na pom gige ding uh ahi; pathian dangte laudan na siam ding uh ahi kei.
Na kiang ua thu ka khun pen na mangngilh ding uh ahi kei; pathian dangte leng laudan na siam ding uh ahi sam kei hi.

TOUPA na Pathian uh laudan na siam ding uh ahi. Huchi in na melma tengteng khut a pan ama'n ahon hunkhe dia, chi a thu akhun a, amau a dia TOUPA thupiakte, dan thusehte, vaihawmte, dan bawlte, azui tuan kei uhi," achi hi.
Bangchi mah in leng azui nuam tuan kei ua, tuma lam a ahihdan bang un ahih lailai uhi.
Huchi in huai namte'n TOUPA alau ua; amilim bawltawmte uh nna leng asem lai uh. Huchi mah bang in asuante uh leh asuante uh suante tan in leng tuni tan in api-le-pute uh hih bang in ahih lailai uhi.
